verdict.rationale: Netlify's CLI clearly supports one-command deploys (`netlify deploy --allow-anonymous`) directly from a working directory with no login required, and docs confirm a full CLI for site/dev management. However, the pack shows no explicit scaffolding command (e.g., project templates or `netlify init`-style scaffolding) — missing for 10: evidence of project scaffolding from templates, independent hands-on confirmation of the single-command flow end-to-end.
